before.text: The item's order system is SIC and Floor Stock is clear in Item - Warehousing (whwmd4600m000). In Item Data by Warehouse (whwmd2510m000), the receiving warehouse's Supply tab has Supply System Time-Phased Order Point, Supply from Warehouse ticked, and the supply company and warehouse. The reorder point is in Item - Ordering (tcibd2600m000), or per site in Items - Ordering by Site (tcibd2150m000). Default Order Types by Origin (whinh0120m000) names the transfer order type for the two warehouses.

tokens.v: TPOP, time-phased order point, pulls stock between warehouses in fixed cycles, such as a supply warehouse feeding a shop floor one. Generating orders compares each warehouse's stock with the reorder point within the order horizon and makes a warehousing transfer order from the supply warehouse.
